title: Show Alya discovering a mysterious glowing artifact that hints at her destiny
narrative_beat: One fateful morning, as the mists still clung to the valley floor, Alya discovered something that would change her path forever. Half-hidden beneath the roots of an ancient oak, she found a crystal that seemed to hum with a song only she could hear.
location_description: Alya kneels beside a crystal-clear stream where an ancient stone altar lies partially buried. A mysterious glowing crystal orb rests upon it, pulsing with soft blue light. Alya reaches toward it with wonder and hesitation, her reflection visible in the water below.
